scope_limits: Two finite separately keyed OFF/ON pairs per power setting, not sustained speech, long duty, all-band or all-microphone qualification. The predeclared development repeat gates are not an independently approved shipping acceptance policy.

All32 retained frames were independently recomputed with the same stated FFT/window convention. Numeric agreement does not calibrate RF watts or ADC headroom, establish FPGA timestamps or prove stability outside those late finite windows.

Scoped ASan/UBSan/LSan instruments exactly the changed model, reader, safety policy, controller and both test translation units. Other aethercore/Qt/dependency code is uninstrumented; this is not a whole-app sanitizer pass.

Source62 macOS ARM build and unsigned artifact digest/CRC/member checks passed. Windows and Intel macOS were still in progress at this checkpoint. These workflows do not run the new selected CTests or opt-in credential/window runtime probes; previous source106/75 evidence is retained with its original scope.

The6300 readiness kit already existed durably; its digest was verified and a current handoff note added without replacing the pinned kit. Actual6300 kernel/CPU/disk/privilege/IQ/RF qualification is still external. Its rear panel lacks the8600 RXA connector; no input routing or RF authorization is inferred.

No natural128sample event or original all-bypass cold-start defect was reproduced or root-caused by these captures. Software-reboot/hang investigation, final process-graph duty/failure matrix, production publisher/catalogue and independent release review remain open.

The final read-only lab audit found unchanged firmware/installation, zero control restarts, cap0 user processes, no packet sockets/ARP residue and accept_local0. Its temporary transport was retired. No reboot, AetherTX launch or processing-settings restore occurred.
